reviewNotes: Twenty-five pregnancy, parenting, spouse-help, pet-bowl, greeting, decorating, and low-mood strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover intended speaker gender, placeholders, exact dialogue tokens and leading or trailing spaces, action markup, household terminology, emotional tone, punctuation, and conversational Romanian; both found no remaining objective issue.
